input.summary: Add a 90-day conformance warranty for Materials with a repair/re-perform/refund remedy and carve the express warranties out of the "AS IS" disclaimer.
input.comment: [Playbook] IBM's warranty covers only care and skill, with no conformance warranty for Materials, no warranty period and no remedy, and Section 5.4(c) then puts all Materials "AS IS". We have added a 90-day conformance and no-malicious-code warranty with a repair, re-performance or refund remedy, and carved the express warranties out of the disclaimer so they are not swallowed.

ops.text: c. for a period of ninety (90) days following delivery, each Material delivered by IBM will conform in all material respects to its documentation and to the specifications in the applicable Service Option Attachment, and will not contain any virus, malicious or disabling code.

Customer's remedy for breach of the warranties in this Section 5.1 is, at IBM's option, re-performance of the non-conforming Services, repair or replacement of the non-conforming Material, or a refund of the charges paid for the non-conforming Services or Material.

ops.oldText: IBM PROVIDES ALL MATERIALS AND ALL NON-IBM SERVICES
ops.newText: EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY WARRANTED IN SECTION 5.1, IBM PROVIDES ALL MATERIALS AND ALL NON-IBM SERVICES
